mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and can impair renal function, increasing ACE inhibitor-induced hyperkalemia and hypotension risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, potassium levels, and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antiviral if possible or adjust lisinopril dosing based on renal function and potassium levels.
